title: Longest String Chain
summary: Given an array of words, each consisting of lowercase English letters, determine the maximum length of a sequence where each word is a predecessor of the next.
statement: Given an array of words, each consisting of lowercase English letters, determine the maximum length of a sequence where each word is a predecessor of the next. A word is a predecessor if exactly one letter can be inserted into the first word to form the second word. The sequence can start with any word and must follow the predecessor rule.
constraints: A predecessor deletes exactly one character from the longer word.
hints: Processing by length guarantees every predecessor state is ready.
Generate all predecessors by deleting each character once.
Set dp[word]=1+maximum predecessor length and track the global maximum.
Every legal chain step is one of those deletions, so the best predecessor yields the best chain ending here.
